issues.title: Shopify OAuth + encrypted token
completedDecisions: AES-256-GCM encryption with TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY env var (32-byte hex)

GET /api/shopify/install: validates shop domain, sets state cookie, redirects to Shopify OAuth
GET /api/shopify/callback: verifies HMAC with timing-safe comparison, exchanges code, encrypts + upserts token
Shopify settings page: shows connection status, ConnectForm, SyncButton
openQuestions: SHOPIFY_API_KEY, SHOPIFY_API_SECRET must be set after creating Custom App in Shopify Partner Dashboard
TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY must be set — generate with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"
